notes.title: Major Update 1.1 - New Threats Lurk In The Deep
notes.content:
The Last Dig just got its first major update! Just to knock you out of your comfort zone, it's time to meet new threats in the abyss.


🚨 SPOILER WARNING
If you don't want to know what else is waiting for you in the deep, now is the time to dive in blind.

The deep won’t wait long.


🛠️ New Threats Below
You'll now be hunted by rival miners who are just as hungry for minerals as you are. These guys are excited for a chance to pick your drill apart for scrap.

If you hear them, it's time to stop drilling. Enemy miners will feel the vibrations from your drill and go on the hunt.
💥 New Attack
To help deal with the new threat, you now have a "dive attack" ability. But make sure you stay stocked up on dynamite, you don't want to have deal with these guys up close.
Patch Notes
Check out the most notable changes below:

New: Added enemy raider miners

New: Added "dive" ability. Press down to point your nose into the abyss and dive attack your enemies

Fix: Tutorial merchant now spawns correctly in cases where player dies just before tutorial starts

Fix: No longer teleporting on some collisions

Fix: Added checks to fix stuck camera zoom

Fix: Animation no longer snaps downward while digging sideways


👍 Make Sure to Leave a Review
Enjoying the game? Make sure to leave a review so the Steam algorithm knows this game is a hidden gem.





That's all for this update. See you in the abyss,

- Mr. Chuckle

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
New: Dead miners now appear with bonus resources
 Change: Made music changes more gradual
 Change: Changed heat upgrade description to be more clear
 Change: Merchants now carry much more stock near the end of the game
 Fix: "Full cargo" warning after selling or spending cargo on upgrades
 Fix: Boss animations are now timed correctly

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content: New: Updated ending; updated behaviors, added new audio, smoothed motion, changed fire graphics and more

notes.title: Full Controller Support
notes.content:
Time for an Upgrade
From day one The Last Dig has been playable with controllers, but hiccuped when you tried to navigate menus. But hiccup no longer! You can fully explore the depths from the comfort of your controller.



XBox One Icons are shown where generic glyphs wouldn't be clear. PlayStation controllers are also supported, only without their own icons.



I hope this gives you another great reason to Wishlist The Last Dig.



See you in the abyss,

- Mr. Chuckle

notes.title: Play the Demo Now!
notes.content:
🎉 The Last Dig is appearing in Steam Next Fest.

notes.title: Demo Release 1.0
notes.content:
🎉 Demo Release – The Last Dig is Now Playable!
The demo for The Last Dig is officially live—and I couldn’t be more excited to share it with you!

I could never quite find the game I wanted: a game about mining into a dark, deep, ancient abyss where anything might be waiting. So I spent the last year building it myself. Now, it's ready for you to play.


[hr][/hr]❤️ Like What You See?
If you're enjoying the demo, please wishlist The Last Dig and share it with friends. Visibility is everything for small indie games and your support makes a huge difference.


[hr][/hr]🗣️ Your Feedback Shapes the Game
This demo is just the beginning. Your feedback is essential to help shape what's next—whether it’s bugs, balance, or bold new ideas.

💬 Share your thoughts in the Steam Discussions.


[hr][/hr]🛠️ What’s Coming Next
I'm squashing bugs as fast as I can so I can get back to building new content. Here's a glimpse at what’s on the horizon:

More lethal threats: Beware new enemies lurking in the abyss

Full controller support: Navigate menus and customize your rig comfortably

More mysteries to uncover: What was that sound? Something’s down there…
